Question: Can you lay out the bathroom renovation schedule as a Gantt chart?

Here is the Harlow Street bathroom schedule based on the renovation plan.

```mermaid
gantt
    title Harlow Street bathroom renovation
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Structure
    Strip-out      :b1, 2026-04-06, 3d
    Waterproofing  :b2, after b1, 2d
    Tiling         :b3, after b2, 5d
    section Fit-out
    Fixtures       :b4, after b3, 3d
    Clean and handover :b5, after b4, 1d
```

- The structural work (strip-out, waterproofing, tiling) takes 10 days in sequence [1].
- Fixtures and handover add another 4 days, so the job runs 14 working days end to end [2].

The Brightline records migration pairs a data track with staff training.

```mermaid
gantt
    title Brightline records migration
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Data
    Export :r1, 2026-10-05, 5d
    Cleansing :r2, after r1, 8d
    Import :r3, after r2, 4d
    section Training
    Front desk :r4, 2026-10-19, 3d
```

- Staff training runs during the cleansing and import steps, so staff are ready at cut-over [2].
